tasks.title: Lecture #69
tasks.instruction: Listen to a talk in a history class.
tasks.transcript:
The Silk Road is an ancient trade route that connected the east and west. The Silk Road was not a single path, but a network of trade routes that spanned thousands of miles, going through the modern day countries of China, and India, and further into Europe.
It played a crucial role in the development of the civilizations it connected. It facilitated not only trade, but also cultural exchange and the spread of ideas. Merchants on the Silk Road traded a wide variety of goods from silk and spices to precious metals and artwork. The route was named after the lucrative trade in silk fabric, which was one of the most sought-after commodities from China.
However, it's important to note that the exchange was not limited to physical goods. It also included knowledge, technology, and religion. For example, Buddhism spread from India to China partly through interactions along the Silk Road. The cities along the route, such as Samarkand and Baghdad, became prosperous centers of commerce and learning. They were melting pots of different cultures, languages, and traditions.
Next, we'll explore the impact of the Silk Road on the economic development of Europe.

questions.stem: What is an important feature of the Silk Road?

options.A: It consisted of multiple routes rather than one single road.
options.B: It had different names in the different countries it connected.
options.C: It was primarily used to trade spices and other foods.

questions.analysis: 答案：A 题目问的是：丝绸之路的一个重要特征是什么？ 定位原文：The Silk Road was not a single path, but a network of trade routes... 选项分析： A. It consisted of multiple routes rather than one single road. 它由多条路线组成，而不是单一的一条道路。说话者明确说“not a single path, but a network”，所以A选项正确。 B. It had different names in the different countries it connected. 它在所连接的不同国家有不同的名称。谈话中未提及，所以B选项错误。 C. It was primarily used to trade spices and other foods. 它主要用于交易香料和其他食品。谈话中提到丝绸是最抢手的商品之一，且交易物品种类繁多，但未说“主要”用于香料和食品，所以C选项错误。 D. It ended in India. 它止于印度。谈话中说丝绸之路延伸到欧洲，不止于印度，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: According to the speaker, the Silk Road contributed to all of the following EXCEPT

options.D: the introduction of new transportation technology

questions.analysis: 答案：D 题目问的是：根据说话者，丝绸之路促进了以下所有内容，除了哪一项？ 定位原文：It facilitated not only trade, but also cultural exchange and the spread of ideas. / the exchange was not limited to physical goods. It also included knowledge, technology, and religion. 选项分析： A. the spread of knowledge 知识的传播。谈话中提到包括知识在内的交流，所以A选项是促进的内容之一。 B. more interactions between countries 国家之间更多的互动。丝绸之路促进了贸易和文化交流，隐含更多互动，所以B选项是促进的内容之一。 C. the exchange of religious ideas 宗教思想的交流。谈话中提到佛教从印度传播到中国部分得益于丝绸之路，所以C选项是促进的内容之一。 D. the introduction of new transportation technology 新运输技术的引入。谈话中未提及运输技术的引入，所以D选项不是丝绸之路促进的内容。

questions.stem: Why does the speaker mention Samarkand and Baghdad?

options.A: To illustrate the variety of items traded along the Silk Road
options.B: To describe the beneficial effect of the Silk Road on cities along its route
options.C: To explain how goods were transported on the Silk Road
options.D: To highlight the length of the Silk Road

questions.analysis: 答案：B 题目问的是：说话者为什么提到撒马尔罕和巴格达？ 定位原文：The cities along the route, such as Samarkand and Baghdad, became prosperous centers of commerce and learning. They were melting pots of different cultures... 选项分析： A. To illustrate the variety of items traded along the Silk Road 说明丝绸之路上交易的物品种类繁多。谈话中提到这两个城市时未讨论具体交易物品，所以A选项错误。 B. To describe the beneficial effect of the Silk Road on cities along its route 描述丝绸之路对其沿线城市的积极影响。说话者说这些城市变得繁荣，成为商业和学术中心，所以B选项正确。 C. To explain how goods were transported on the Silk Road 解释货物如何在丝绸之路上运输。谈话中未提及运输方式，所以C选项错误。 D. To highlight the length of the Silk Road 强调丝绸之路的长度。谈话中提到这两个城市时未讨论长度，所以D选项错误。

questions.stem: What will the speaker most likely discuss next?

options.A: The sea trade routes that existed at the time of the Silk Road
options.B: The role of merchants in cultural exchange
options.C: The impact of the Silk Road on European economies
options.D: The history of Buddhism in China

questions.analysis: 答案：C 题目问的是：说话者接下来最可能讨论什么？ 定位原文：Next, we'll explore the impact of the Silk Road on the economic development of Europe. 选项分析： A. The sea trade routes that existed at the time of the Silk Road 丝绸之路时期的海洋贸易路线。谈话中未提及，所以A选项错误。 B. The role of merchants in cultural exchange 商人在文化交流中的作用。谈话中未明确说接下来要讲这个，所以B选项错误。 C. The impact of the Silk Road on European economies 丝绸之路对欧洲经济的影响。说话者明确说接下来要探讨丝绸之路对欧洲经济发展的影响，所以C选项正确。 D. The history of Buddhism in China 佛教在中国的历史。谈话中提到佛教传播，但未说接下来要讲这个，所以D选项错误。
